title: Cool weather expected in PH despite Super El Niño — Pagasa

blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan — Residents of Northern Luzon and other parts of the country can expect chilly weather in December and January despite a potentially strong El Niño forecast from October through the first half of 2027, according to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa). Jose Estrada Jr., chief of Pagasa’s Dagupan City station, said the northeast monsoon, locally known as amihan, would continue to bring cold winds to the country even as El Niño threatens to reduce rainfall. Estrada explained that El Niño and the northeast monsoon are driven by different atmospheric and oceanic conditions. READ: ‘Amihan’ season […]...
